title: Consumer Product Packaging Study
background: This study evaluates consumer purchase intent for packaging designs across Bulgaria, Greece, and Saudi Arabia. Respondents will evaluate combinations of packaging design elements to identify which elements and combinations generate the highest purchase intent. The study targets a broad mass-market audience with balanced demographic representation across gender and age groups.
orientation_text:
Welcome! Thank you for participating in this study.

You will be shown a series of packaging designs, one at a time.
Please rate each design independently based on your first impression. Do not compare designs with one another.
There are no right or wrong answers—we are interested in your personal assessment.

For each design, please answer:
“Would you buy this product?”

• 1 = Definitely would not buy
• 2 = Probably would not buy
• 3 = Might or might not buy
• 4 = Probably would buy
• 5 = Definitely would buy
